Here’s what you can do: Choose the Right Format: Use WebP format whenever possible.
Compress Images: Use tools like TinyPNG or ImageOptim to reduce file sizes without noticeable quality loss.
Use a Content Delivery Network (CDN): A CDN distributes your website’s files across multiple servers around the world
This dramatically reduces loading times for users in different locations.
Third-party scripts can significantly slow down your website.
Here’s how to reduce their impact: Remove Unnecessary Plugins: Audit your plugins and remove any that you don’t need.
Defer Loading of Non-Critical Scripts: Defer loading of scripts that aren’t essential for the initial page load.
